versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11002 The value of ( OsScheduleTableMaxLengthen + delay_from_previous_EP) of an expiry point shall be less than the OsCounterMaxAllowedValue of the underlying Counter .
The value of ( OsScheduleTableMaxLengthen + delay_from_ previous_EP) of an expiry point shall be less than the OsCounterMaxAllowedValue of the underlying Counter .
